result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module failing and not failing over
result_summary.description: Our SSO Integration Module in the US-West production environment is experiencing intermittent failures, leading to a partial outage. When these failures occur, the system does not trigger failover as expected, resulting in about 37 users being unable to log in. We are confident this is a capacity limitation issue on your end, causing the system to crash under load rather than properly routing traffic to a backup. Please address this capacity problem urgently.
